entities.summary: Lee Jun-seok is a South Korean politician who has served as the leader of the Reform Party since 2025 and as the member of the National Assembly for Hwaseong B since 2024. The founder of the Reform Party, he was the party's nominee in the 2025 presidential election and had previously served as its leader from January to May 2024.
